rows.question: Blaidd là ai và phục vụ ai?

response.answer: Blaidd the Half-Wolf là một NPC trong Elden Ring (2022), một chiến binh nửa sói và là "cái bóng" trung thành hầu cận Lunar Princess Ranni [1]. Trong đoạn hội thoại sau khi Tarnished gia nhập phe của mình, Ranni cũng tự gọi Blaidd là "một chiến binh nửa sói trong hàng ngũ tôi" và sai anh cùng Tarnished đi tìm bảo vật ẩn giấu của Nokron, Eternal City [3].

sources.title: Blaidd the Half-Wolf
sources.text: Blaidd the Half-Wolf is an NPC in ELDEN RING (2022). He is a half-wolf warrior in service to Lunar Princess Ranni and serves as her faithful shadow.

sources.title: Ranni the Witch
sources.text:
After entering Ranni's service (before Radahn Festival)
Good, then I ask we proceed with haste.
There is, in my service, a half-wolven warrior by the name of Blaidd.
I would have thee join him in searching for the hidden treasure of Nokron, the Eternal City.
I have called for Blaidd to greet thee below. Take from him the particulars.
Ah, and there wilt thou find Iji, my war counselor, and Seluvis, preceptor in the sorcerous arts, also.
Heed not their peculiarities; feel secure in gaining from them what advantage thou canst.
I am sure the others will be doing just the same.

rows.question: Flame, Cleanse Me giúp xử lý poison và scarlet rot như thế nào?

response.answer:
Flame, Cleanse Me vừa làm giảm tích tụ (buildup) poison và scarlet rot, vừa chữa khỏi hẳn hai trạng thái này nếu bạn đã bị dính — đúng như mô tả: nó tạo ra ngọn lửa thiêu rụi độc tố trong cơ thể [1]. Đổi lại, phép này để lại những vết bỏng nhẹ trên người người niệm, một chi tiết mang tính lore nhắc rằng họ phải sợ ngọn lửa [1].

Vì vậy nó đặc biệt hữu ích ở những vùng đầy rot như Lake of Rot, nơi các cách loại bỏ Scarlet Rot ngoài Flame, Cleanse Me khá hiếm [4].

sources.title: Flame, Cleanse Me
sources.text:
One of the incantations of the Fire Monks.
Creates a fire within that burns away toxins. Alleviates poison and scarlet rot buildup and cures these ailments.
This incantation leaves the caster with subtle burns—a reminder that they must fear the flame.

sources.title: Speckled Hardtear
sources.text: Very useful for the Lake of Rot, due to Scarlet Rot-removing methods besides Flame, Cleanse Me being rare.

rows.question: What warrior name does Godfrey use when he abandons his royal identity?

response.answer: Hoarah Loux. After the Long March, Godfrey set aside his kingship and became a simple warrior again, and it was as Hoarah Loux that he became a chieftain of the Badlands [2][5]. The game also refers to him directly as "Hoarah Loux, Warrior" [3].

sources.title: Remembrance of Hoarah Loux
sources.text:
Remembrance of the warrior Hoarah Loux, hewn into the Erdtree.
The power of its namesake can be unlocked by the Finger Reader.
Alternatively, it can be used to gain a bounty of runes.
When Godfrey, first Elden Lord, was robbed of his grace, becoming Tarnished, he took with him his kinfolk and left the Lands Between.
After the Long March of the Tarnished came to an end, Godfrey divested himself of kingship, becoming a simple warrior once more.

sources.title: Godfrey, First Elden Lord
sources.text: Godfrey, First Elden Lord, or Hoarah Loux, Warrior, is a mandatory boss in ELDEN RING (2022). The first encounter is in Leyndell, Royal Capital and the second is in Leyndell, Ashen Capital.

sources.title: Godfrey, First Elden Lord
sources.text:
As the Lord of the Battlefield, Godfrey fought in many battles. During the siege of Castle Morne, Godfrey bested a lone hero who fought for vengeance. On top of leading the war against the Giants, he faced the Storm Lord alone. However, when his last enemy fell, it is said that the hue of Godfrey's eyes faded. At the end of his campaign, although his golden armies were unvanquished and unbowed, he found his Grace lost, tattered and faded. He and his warriors were addressed by Queen Marika, who informed them that she had divested them of their Grace. She commanded them to leave the Lands Between, to wage war in a land afar, where they would live and die. Thus, Godfrey and his kinfolk became the first Tarnished, and left the Lands Between together on a pilgrimage known as the Long March, at the end of which Godfrey divested himself of kingship and became a simple warrior once more.
Godfrey became a chieftain of the Badlands, under the name of Hoarah Loux. Although the head of his axe had been broken in a battle fought during the Long March, his loyal warriors honored him by wielding axes of their own, and they became the weapon of choice for Badlands chieftains.

rows.question: Is Maliketh optional if I want to unlock Leyndell, Ashen Capital?

response.answer: No — Maliketh is required for that transition. Defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade is what unbinds the Rune of Death and turns Leyndell into the Ashen Capital, so the fight isn't optional if your goal is reaching that version of the city and the endgame [1][2].

sources.title: Maliketh, the Black Blade
sources.text: Maliketh, the Black Blade is a boss in ELDEN RING (2022), encountered in Crumbling Farum Azula. This is not an optional boss as Maliketh must be defeated to unlock Leyndell, Ashen Capital and reach the endgame of Elden Ring.

sources.title: Leyndell, Ashen Capital
sources.text:
With the defeat of Maliketh, the Black Blade, the Rune of Death is unbound, and the Flame of Ruin burns away the impenetrable thorns blocking the entrance to the Erdtree. The city of Leyndell is blanketed in thick ash, burying all but the tallest buildings. The Tarnished returns to the city after releasing the Rune of Death, finally able to approach the Erdtree and gain entry.
The Eastern Capital Ramparts remains accessible, serving as the remaining access point that links the Ashen Capital with the rest of the world. The Capital Outskirts and beyond remain unchanged.
While the Ashen Capital replaces the Royal Capital and most of its landmarks are rendered inaccessible, a few key areas can be reached via alternate routes:
It is still possible to access the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds from this version of Leyndell. A manhole cover in the center of the region that was previously closed is now open, allowing for one to drop down into the sewers below. The Crimson Amber Medallion +2 is also located on a beam that is only accessible here.
The Divine Bridge Site of Grace that leads to the waygate to the Isolated Divine Tower can no longer be accessed from the Fortified Manor. The only way to get there now is to use the teleporter trap atop the Tower of Return.
While the gate that leads from the capital center to the Mountaintops of the Giants is blocked shut, you can travel backwards along that pathway. The lake that once was inaccessible is now filled with ash and debris, and amidst the Ulcerated Tree Spirits that patrol the lake is Erdtree's Favor +2.

rows.question: I gave Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade. What next?

response.answer:
Giving Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade gets you the Carian Inverted Statue; note that this immediately ends Preceptor Seluvis's quest, and Seluvis dies at this stage [4][5]. Renna's Rise then opens — climb to the top and take the sending gate to the upper Ainsel River, pick up the Miniature Ranni near the spawn point, rest at the Ainsel River Main Site of Grace, and use "Talk to miniature Ranni" three times to get her speaking [4].

From there, head through Nokstella: defeat the Baleful Shadow invader just past the Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace to get the Discarded Palace Key, then open the chest in Rennala's boss room at the Academy of Raya Lucaria for the Dark Moon Ring [4]. Next, beat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void at the end of the Lake of Rot — the lift up only works once you have the Dark Moon Ring — and go to the Cathedral of Manus Celes, descend the tunnel near the altar to Ranni sitting on the corpse of her Two Fingers, interact for the cutscene, then speak to her again to receive the Dark Moon Greatsword [4]. Finally, after the final boss, a blue summon sign appears on the Stone Platform in the Ashen Capital; using it summons Ranni and leads to the Age of the Stars ending [4].

sources.title: Ranni the Witch
sources.text:
Bring the Fingerslayer Blade to Ranni, who will give you the Carian Inverted Statue. This key item is required for Fia's questline, however it is not necessary to complete Ranni's questline.
WARNING: This will immediately end Preceptor Seluvis's quest.
Ainsel River
Renna's Rise will now be open after giving Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade. Enter and climb to the top, and go through the sending gate to the upper portion of Ainsel River.
Pick up the Miniature Ranni near the spawn point and rest at the Ainsel River Main Site of Grace. Use the "Talk to miniature Ranni" option three times to get her to speak.
(Optional) Ranni will also have dialogue at the Nokstella, Eternal City and Nokstella Waterfall Basin Sites of Grace. These are not required to continue her questline.
Defeat the Baleful Shadow invader just past the Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace to obtain the Discarded Palace Key. Go to Rennala's boss room in Academy of Raya Lucaria and unlock the chest to obtain the Dark Moon Ring.
Moonlight Altar
Defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void at the end of the Lake of Rot and travel up the lift. This lift only unlocks if you have obtained the Dark Moon Ring.
Travel to the Cathedral of Manus Celes and descend through the tunnel near the altar to find Ranni sitting on the corpse of her Two Fingers. Interact with her to trigger a cutscene. After the cutscene, speak to her again and she will disappear, leaving behind the Dark Moon Greatsword.
Leyndell, Ashen Capital
After defeating the final boss, there will be a blue summon sign on the Stone Platform. Interact with it to summon Ranni, allowing you to achieve the Age of the Stars ending.

sources.title: Preceptor Seluvis
sources.text:
Return to Seluvis and select the "About your chambers" dialogue option. You will now be able to buy puppets from Seluvis in return for Starlight Shards. Buy any one of these puppets to continue.
Speak to Seluvis again and select the "About the scheme" dialogue option.
Obtain the Amber Starlight from Altus Plateau. This can be found in a small grotto north-east of the Altus Highway Junction Site of Grace, north of the giant staircase that leads to the Tree Sentinel boss fight.
Return to Seluvis and select the "Give Amber Starlight" dialogue option to obtain the Magic Scorpion Charm.
Reload the area and speak to Seluvis to obtain the Amber Draught.
You may attempt to give the Amber Draught to Ranni. Doing so will lock Ranni's questline, and it can only be resumed by seeking Absolution at the Church of Vows. Talking to her three times after trying to give her the draught will cause her to instantly kill you.
Seluvis will now be dead. His Bell bearing and armour set can be looted from his body, which can also be interacted with to access the puppet shop. Pidia will also die at this stage.
If Ranni is not given the Amber Draught, Seluvis will die in the same way after giving her the Fingerslayer Blade.

{"answer":"Blaidd the Half-Wolf là một NPC trong Elden Ring (2022), một chiến binh nửa sói và là \"cái bóng\" trung thành hầu cận Lunar Princess Ranni [1]. Trong đoạn hội thoại sau khi Tarnished gia nhập phe của mình, Ranni cũng tự gọi Blaidd là \"một chiến binh nửa sói trong hàng ngũ tôi\" và sai anh cùng Tarnished đi tìm bảo vật ẩn giấu của Nokron, Eternal City [3].","evidence":[{"index":1,"quote_id":"q0"},{"index":3,"quote_id":"q0"}],"insufficient":false}

{"answer":"Flame, Cleanse Me vừa làm giảm tích tụ (buildup) poison và scarlet rot, vừa chữa khỏi hẳn hai trạng thái này nếu bạn đã bị dính — đúng như mô tả: nó tạo ra ngọn lửa thiêu rụi độc tố trong cơ thể [1]. Đổi lại, phép này để lại những vết bỏng nhẹ trên người người niệm, một chi tiết mang tính lore nhắc rằng họ phải sợ ngọn lửa [1].\n\nVì vậy nó đặc biệt hữu ích ở những vùng đầy rot như Lake of Rot, nơi các cách loại bỏ Scarlet Rot ngoài Flame, Cleanse Me khá hiếm [4].","evidence":[{"index":1,"quote_ids":["q0"]},{"index":4,"quote_ids":["q0"]}],"insufficient":false}

{"answer":"Giving Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade gets you the Carian Inverted Statue; note that this immediately ends Preceptor Seluvis's quest, and Seluvis dies at this stage [4][5]. Renna's Rise then opens — climb to the top and take the sending gate to the upper Ainsel River, pick up the Miniature Ranni near the spawn point, rest at the Ainsel River Main Site of Grace, and use \"Talk to miniature Ranni\" three times to get her speaking [4].\n\nFrom there, head through Nokstella: defeat the Baleful Shadow invader just past the Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace to get the Discarded Palace Key, then open the chest in Rennala's boss room at the Academy of Raya Lucaria for the Dark Moon Ring [4]. Next, beat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void at the end of the Lake of Rot — the lift up only works once you have the Dark Moon Ring — and go to the Cathedral of Manus Celes, descend the tunnel near the altar to Ranni sitting on the corpse of her Two Fingers, interact for the cutscene, then speak to her again to receive the Dark Moon Greatsword [4]. Finally, after the final boss, a blue summon sign appears on the Stone Platform in the Ashen Capital; using it summons Ranni and leads to the Age of the Stars ending [4].","evidence":[{"index":4,"quote_ids":["q0"]},{"index":5,"quote_ids":["q0"]}],"insufficient":false}
